CHAP USTUN - 'Reading':
17a) 'Read the following story, and put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.' SURAT: Venetsiya - kanal ustidagi oq ko'prik, gondolalar. MATN (pushti qog'oz): 'Venice, with its many ancient buildings 1) ...... (look) beautiful on such a clear summer's day. The sun 2) ...... (shine) brightly over the calm waters as James and Elsa 3) ...... (reach) the Grand Canal, where a gondola 4) ...... (wait) for them. "I thought I'd surprise you with a boat ride," said James. While they 5) ...... (travel) along the canal, they 6) ...... (stop) a few times so that Elsa 7) ...... (can) admire the wonderful churches and monuments. Their guide helpfully 8) ...... (tell) them the name of each place. As other boats 9) ...... (pass) them, their cheerful passengers 10) ...... (wave) and 11) ...... (smile) at the happy couple. Laughter, music and the delicious smell of Italian cooking 12) ...... (fill) the air. When they 13) ...... (approach) Rialto Bridge, they suddenly 14) ...... (hear) a loud roar. A motorboat 15) ...... (speed) towards them! As it 16) ...... (rush) past, a huge wave 17) ...... (splash) James and Elsa with dirty canal water. The guide 18) ...... (fall) backwards and 19) ...... (shout) angrily at the people in the motorboat. "Oh dear," 20) ...... (laugh) James. "Perhaps a gondola ride wasn't such a peaceful and romantic idea after all!"'
17b) 'Correct the sentences, as in the example.' 1 A helicopter was waiting for them. ...No, it wasn't. A gondola was waiting for them.... 2 Elsa admired the wonderful statues. 3 They suddenly heard a loud splash. 4 A car was speeding towards them. 5 James shouted at the people in the motorboat.

O'NG USTUN - 'Writing (a story)':
18) 'Look at the pictures and match the sentences to the pictures, then write the events in the order they happened. Finally, tell the story.' 6 RASM: A - Carlos velosiped bilan, uy oldida qo'l silkitib xayrlashyapti (buvisi-bobosi eshikda); B - Carlos toshloq joyda tosh sindiryapti, velosiped yonida; C - bobosi tuxumni ushlab hayratda, Carlos yonida; D - avtobusda odamlar, Carlos qutini ushlab o'tiribdi; E - toshloq joyda bir necha kishi (olimlar) turibdi; F - gazeta 'ARGENTINA NEWS - Dinosaur Egg Found', Carlos surati.
  GAPLAR (katakchali): 1 Carlos's grandfather couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the egg and immediately called the authorities to tell them the exciting news. 2 Carlos felt very proud that his story appeared in every newspaper, and he even gave some interviews on television. 3 One summer morning, as he waved goodbye to his grandparents and set off on his bicycle, Carlos had a feeling that it was going to be a very special day. 4 A few hours later, Carlos was breaking some rocks to look for fossils inside, when he noticed a strange-looking rock. 5 Early the next morning, Carlos set off on the long hot bus journey to the Carmen Funes Museum in Plaza Huincul with his precious egg. 6 Over the next few months, scientists found hundreds more dinosaur eggs.
19) 'Use the information from Ex. 18, as well as your own ideas, to write a story entitled "Carlos's Lucky Find" (120-180 words).'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the following story, and put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (James and Elsa in Venice)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi hikoyani o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (Jeyms va Elza Venetsiyada)
exercises.explanationUz:
GONDOLA SAYRI - PAST SIMPLE va
  CONTINUOUS ARALASh.

  PAST CONTINUOUS (fon, davomiy):
    2 was shining (as they reached)
    4 was waiting
    5 were travelling (while)
    13 were approaching (when)
    15 was speeding
  PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
    looked, reached, stopped, could,
    told, passed, waved, smiled,
    filled, heard, rushed, splashed,
    fell, shouted, laughed


⚠ 'CAN' → 'COULD':

  'so that Elsa COULD admire' -
  o'tgan zamon.


⚠ NOQONUNIY:

  tell → TOLD, hear → HEARD,
  fall → FELL.


⚠ VENETSIYA:

  the Grand Canal = Katta kanal
  Rialto Bridge = Rialto ko'prigi
  (5-betda surati bor edi!)
  a gondola = gondola (Venetsiya
  qayig'i)


⚠ 'TO ADMIRE':

  = zavqlanib tomosha qilmoq.


⚠ 'A ROAR':

  = gumburlash, na'ra (motor
  ovozi).


⚠ 'A MOTORBOAT':

  = motorli qayiq.


⚠ 'TO SPLASH':

  = suv sachratmoq.


⚠ 'AFTER ALL':

  = oxir-oqibat, aslida.


⚠ 'I THOUGHT I'D SURPRISE YOU':

  = seni hayratda qoldirmoqchi edim
  ('I'd' = I would).

items.textEn: Venice, with its many ancient buildings ___ (look) beautiful on such a clear summer's day.
The sun ___ (shine) brightly over the calm waters as James and Elsa ___ (reach) the Grand Canal,
where a gondola ___ (wait) for them. "I thought I'd surprise you with a boat ride," said James.
While they ___ (travel) along the canal, they ___ (stop) a few times so that Elsa ___ (can) admire the wonderful churches and monuments.
Their guide helpfully ___ (tell) them the name of each place.
As other boats ___ (pass) them, their cheerful passengers ___ (wave) and ___ (smile) at the happy couple.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Har safar o'tganda - takrorlanuvchi voqealar → past simple (uchalasi).

items.textEn: Laughter, music and the delicious smell of Italian cooking ___ (fill) the air.
When they ___ (approach) Rialto Bridge, they suddenly ___ (hear) a loud roar.
As it ___ (rush) past, a huge wave ___ (splash) James and Elsa with dirty canal water.
The guide ___ (fall) backwards and ___ (shout) angrily at the people in the motorboat.
"Oh dear," ___ (laugh) James. "Perhaps a gondola ride wasn't such a peaceful and romantic idea after all!"

exercises.explanationUz:
TUZATISh QOLIPI (coursebook
  30-bet 22b):

  No, it wasn't / she didn't / they
  didn't. + TO'G'RI FAKT.

  ⚠ Inkor qisqa javob - gapdagi
  yordamchi fe'lga mos:
  was waiting → No, it WASN'T.
  admired → No, she DIDN'T.
  heard → No, they DIDN'T.
  was speeding → No, it WASN'T.
  shouted → No, he DIDN'T.


MATNDAGI FAKTLAR:

  1 gondola kutayotgan edi
  2 cherkov va yodgorliklarni
    tomosha qildi (haykallar EMAS)
  3 baland NA'RA eshitdilar (suv
    shovqini EMAS)
  4 MOTORLI QAYIQ kelayotgan edi
  5 GID qichqirdi (Jeyms kuldi)

No, they didn't. They suddenly heard a loud roar.

Yo'q. Ular to'satdan baland na'ra eshitdilar.
Yo'q. Ular tomon motorli qayiq kelayotgan edi.
Yo'q. Motorli qayiqdagi odamlarga gid qichqirdi.

exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va gaplarni rasmlarga moslang, so'ng voqealarni sodir bo'lgan tartibda yozing. Oxirida hikoyani aytib bering. Rasmlar: A Carlos velosipedda xayrlashyapti; B Carlos tosh sindiryapti; C bobosi tuxumni ushlab turibdi; D Carlos avtobusda; E olimlar joyda; F gazeta 'Dinozavr tuxumi topildi'.
exercises.explanationUz:
CARLOSNING OMADLI TOPILMASI -
  VOQEALAR TARTIBI.

  TO'G'RI TARTIB:
  1) gap 3 - A: bir kuni ertalab
     xayrlashib, velosipedda
     jo'nadi
  2) gap 4 - B: tosh sindirib
     qazilma qidirayotganda g'alati
     toshni payqadi
  3) gap 1 - C: bobosi tuxumni
     ko'rib ishonolmadi, rasmiylarga
     xabar berdi
  4) gap 5 - D: ertasi kuni
     avtobusda muzeyga bordi
  5) gap 6 - E: keyingi oylarda
     olimlar yuzlab tuxum topdi
  6) gap 2 - F: hikoyasi gazetalarda
     chiqdi, TV intervyu


⚠ VAQT BELGILARI:

  'One summer morning' - boshlanish
  'A few hours later' - keyin
  'Early the next morning' - ertasi
  'Over the next few months'


⚠ 'A FOSSIL':

  = qazilma (toshga aylangan
  qadimiy jonzot qoldig'i).


⚠ 'THE AUTHORITIES':

  = rasmiy idoralar, hokimiyat.


⚠ 'PRECIOUS':

  = qimmatbaho, aziz.


⚠ 'TO SET OFF':

  = yo'lga chiqmoq.


⚠ PLAZA HUINCUL:

  = Argentinadagi shahar (Neuquén),
  Carmen Funes muzeyi - dinozavr
  qazilmalari bilan mashhur
  (haqiqiy joy!).


⚠ 'COULDN'T BELIEVE HIS EYES':

  = ko'zlariga ishonolmadi.

modelAnswers:
Carlos's Lucky Find

One summer morning, as he waved goodbye to his grandparents and set off on his bicycle, Carlos had a feeling that it was going to be a very special day. The sun was shining and the sky was clear as he rode towards the hills.

A few hours later, Carlos was breaking some rocks to look for fossils inside, when he noticed a strange-looking rock. It was round and smooth. "That's not a rock!" he thought excitedly. "It's an egg!" He carefully put it in his bag and cycled home as fast as he could.

Carlos's grandfather couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the egg and immediately called the authorities to tell them the exciting news. Early the next morning, Carlos set off on the long hot bus journey to the Carmen Funes Museum in Plaza Huincul with his precious egg. The scientists there were amazed. It was a dinosaur egg!

Over the next few months, scientists found hundreds more dinosaur eggs in the same place. Carlos felt very proud that his story appeared in every newspaper, and he even gave some interviews on television. It really was a day to remember!

Bir kuni yoz ertalabi, buvisi-bobosi bilan xayrlashib velosipedda yo'lga chiqarkan, Carlos bu juda alohida kun bo'lishini his qildi. Tepaliklar tomon ketarkan quyosh porlab, osmon musaffo edi.

Bir necha soatdan keyin Carlos ichidan qazilma qidirish uchun toshlarni sindirayotganda g'alati ko'rinishli toshni payqadi. U yumaloq va silliq edi. "Bu tosh emas!" deb o'yladi u hayajon bilan. "Bu tuxum!" U uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan sumkasiga solib, iloji boricha tez uyga haydadi.

Carlosning bobosi tuxumni ko'rganda ko'zlariga ishonolmadi va darhol rasmiylarga qo'ng'iroq qilib hayajonli yangilikni aytdi. Ertasi kuni erta tongda Carlos qimmatbaho tuxumi bilan Plaza Huinkuldagi Karmen Funes muzeyiga uzoq va issiq avtobus safariga chiqdi. U yerdagi olimlar hayratda qolishdi. Bu dinozavr tuxumi edi!

Keyingi bir necha oy davomida olimlar o'sha joydan yana yuzlab dinozavr tuxumlarini topdilar. Carlos hikoyasi har bir gazetada chiqqanidan juda faxrlandi va hatto televideniyeda bir necha intervyu ham berdi. Bu chindan ham esda qoladigan kun edi!

patterns.formula: While X were + V-ing, X + V2 so that Y could + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: While they were travelling along the canal, they stopped so that Elsa could admire the churches.
patterns.exampleUz: Kanal bo'ylab ketayotganlarida Elza cherkovlarni tomosha qilishi uchun to'xtashdi.

patterns.formula: No, it wasn't. / No, she didn't. + TO'G'RI FAKT.
patterns.exampleEn: No, it wasn't. A gondola was waiting for them.

patterns.formula: X couldn't believe his eyes when he saw ...
patterns.exampleEn: Carlos's grandfather couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the egg.
patterns.exampleUz: Carlosning bobosi tuxumni ko'rganda ko'zlariga ishonolmadi.

patterns.formula: Over the next few months, X + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: Over the next few months, scientists found hundreds more eggs.
patterns.exampleUz: Keyingi bir necha oy davomida olimlar yana yuzlab tuxum topdilar.
